blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is planning to deploy a liaison officer to India’s maritime information-sharing center to strengthen cooperation in monitoring activities at sea, the Department of National Defense (DND) said on Thursday. Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. committed to facilitating the deployment of a Philippine officer to India’s Information Fusion Center–Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR) during a meeting with Indian Defense Minister Rajnath Singh on Wednesday on the sidelines of the 13th Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting-Plus in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu.
